listing.name: Vagrant Story (Vagrant Story Recompiled)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Windowsrelease is a ROM-free runtime/bootstrapper. Reads own disc and backgroundcompiles battleengine/menus/title with bundledgcc; interpreter/TinyCC executes remaining code. Upstream owns generated code/cache. MSVC source build is separate. Limits: Upstream only: Background compilation covers battle/menu/title code; interpreter/TinyCC handles the remainder. Full-game/native coverage remains bounded. ROM-free Windows build reads original code; first-launch gcc compiles battle/menu/title engine; interpreter/TinyCC handles remainder. Preserve hybrid implementation and startup compile scope. Upstream platforms: Windows MSVC source build and release with bundled gcc/TinyCC. Other player platforms not established. Original data: PS1 Vagrant Story USA SLUS-01040 own disc. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
